description_en: Binds a key pair to simple application servers
description_zh: 轻量应用服务器绑定密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open attach-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --biz-key-pair-name test --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of simple application servers. You can specify a maximum of 50 IDs of simple application servers
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例ID。最多支持50个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair that you want to bind to the simple application server. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter but cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

FailCount.description_en: The total number of simple application servers to which the key pair failed to be bound
FailCount.description_zh: 绑定密钥对失败的实例总数量

items.description_zh: 绑定密钥对成功或失败的结果集合

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the key pair is bound to the simple application server successfully. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
绑定密钥对是否成功。可能值：

true：绑定密钥对成功。

false：绑定密钥对失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of simple application servers to which the key pair is bound
TotalCount.description_zh: 绑定密钥对的实例总数量
